name: @dsh-external/dsh-sec-enforce
description: DSH host-plane deterministic enforcement for the five security presets : ctx.tools.guard() pre-execute interception — report files require a stage_gate PASS in gate-log.md, writes stay inside the task workspace (least privilege), conservative high-risk bash patterns must go through the ask-first flow, and bare full-port scans without rate controls are rejected with the fix. Guards fire only for the five security presets; every denial appends to the workspace enforce-log.md.
author: SeaOf0
